taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Trial eligibility lineage across organization deletion and recreation
controls.source_trace: Identify the declared unit of eligibility and where prior benefit history survives recreation or identity changes.
controls.implementation_branch: Decide whether eligibility attaches to person, organization, payment instrument or product; do not impose an invented global rule. Distinguish a new independent organization from reusing the same eligibility identity. The effect must be an additional allowed benefit, not merely an account creation or trial-label response.
controls.operational_method: Specialize in organization deletion/recreation and eligibility lineage. Retain the product-defined eligibility key and any surviving usage/tombstone record when a new organization ID is allocated. Compare recreated identity with a genuinely independent eligible organization; do not impose one-person or payment-instrument rules the product never declared. No real payment instrument or additional personal-data retention is required for the synthetic lifecycle fixture.
controls.controlled_verification: Create an owned organization eligibility lineage, consume its trial, delete it and recreate a new organization ID under the same declared lineage. Compare a genuinely independent eligible organization; no real payment or identity data is required.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Multiple trials can be intentional for separate organizations; demonstrate violation of the actual benefit rule rather than assuming one trial per human.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce the declared eligibility identity and retention policy while preserving legitimate new-customer trials.
